description: This file declares the VideoTrackSourceImpl class, which implements a WebRTC video track source, and a wrapper class for handling video frames via the VideoSink interface within the WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl
classes.description: Implements a WebRTC video track source, managing video frames and providing statistics and support for encoded output.

classes.name: VideoTrackSourceImplSinkWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a VideoTrackSourceImpl object to conform to the VideoSink interface, enabling it to receive video frames.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video source with specified width and height.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Handles incoming video frames with associated timestamps.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics about the video source, returns false if unavailable.

methods.name: SupportsEncodedOutput
methods.description: Indicates whether the source supports encoded output.

methods.name: GenerateKeyFrame
methods.description: Placeholder for generating a key frame; currently does nothing.

methods.name: AddEncodedSink
methods.description: Adds an encoded sink; currently a no-op.

methods.name: RemoveEncodedSink
methods.description: Removes an encoded sink; currently a no-op.

methods.name: VideoTrackSourceImplSinkWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the wrapper with a reference-counted pointer to the video source.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Receives a video frame and forwards it to the wrapped video source.
